description: This PHP class file defines the CloudTrailDataClient, a client to interact with the AWS CloudTrail Data Service, extending the AwsClient base class. It declares methods for placing audit events synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: CloudTrailDataClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS CloudTrail Data Service operations, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: putAuditEvents
methods.description: Method to synchronously send audit events to AWS CloudTrail Data Service.

methods.name: putAuditEventsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant of putAuditEvents, returning a promise.
